model.combine: per-pixel maximum over tracks that see the pixel

vs_rules.note: Flood water only: the model was trained on water labels and does not detect debris; model-only water is added to the map only where water can pond (low and flat), at low confidence.

access.speeds: nominal free-flow speeds per OSM road class (OSRM car-profile defaults)

notes: Plains terrain (UNEP-WCMC mountain definition): flooding is mapped as water; the debris class applies only to mountain terrain.

criteria.slope_source: US Army FM 3-21.38 Pathfinder Operations: ground slope up to 7 degrees acceptable for landing

helicopter_access.not_checked: trees, buildings or power lines missing from OpenStreetMap, soft or loose ground, wind, the approach path, and flood or debris our map missed (it misses much of the debris in mountain valleys)
